back_translation: Come, let us return to the LORD, for He has torn us, but He will heal us; He has wounded us, but He will bind up our wounds.
After two days He will revive us; on the third day He will raise us up, that we may live in His presence.
Let us know, let us press on to know the LORD. He will surely come like the dawn; He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.
O Ephraim, what shall I do with you? O Judah, what shall I do with you? For your steadfast love is like a morning mist, like the dew that vanishes early in the morning.
Therefore I have hewn them down by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of My mouth, and My judgments go forth like light.
For I desire steadfast love, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
But they, like Adam, have transgressed the covenant; there they were treacherous against Me.
Gilead is a city of evildoers, stained with bloody footprints.
Like robbers lying in ambush, a band of priests murder people on the way to Shechem; they have committed horrible wickedness.
In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing: the harlotry of Ephraim; Israel is defiled.
O Judah, for you too a harvest is appointed, when I restore My people from captivity.
